text:
`requirements.md` has been updated to incorporate all Gate 1 revisions:

1. **FR-11 (`DefaultNamespaceEntityPolicy.enforce`)**: Updated to state that `enforce` resolves with the original `entity` untouched when `entity.metadata.namespace` is truthy; otherwise it resolves with a new deep copy (`lodash.merge` onto `{ metadata: { namespace: <default> } }`) in which the default namespace is applied only when `metadata.namespace` is absent or `undefined`, while `''` and `null` are kept as they are in the returned copy, and the input `entity` is never changed.
2. **FR-1 to FR-8, In scope, Out of scope, and AC-1**: Scoped strictly to the 24 top-level `apiVersion`, `kind`, and `spec` members across the 8 kind interfaces, removing all inner `spec` field bullets, removing any claim about owner `allowedKinds`, and adding comments on fields inside `spec` to **Out of scope**.
3. **FR-10.1 (`isValidApiVersion`), FR-10.5 (`isValidLabelKey`), and FR-10.7 (`isValidAnnotationKey`)**: Updated the DNS subdomain description to state that a DNS subdomain is 1–253 characters of dot-separated DNS labels, where each label is 1–63 characters of lowercase ASCII letters and digits (`[a-z0-9]`), starting and ending with one, with internal hyphens (`-`) allowed (`CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsLabel`: `/^[a-z0-9]+(?:\-+[a-z0-9]+)*$/`).
